hook.text: A concept album whose lyrics draw on religion and divinity, the fourth record from a Danish progressive metal band.

facts.label: Label
facts.value: Teichiku Records (Japan), Magna Carta Records (USA), Semaphore Records (Europe)

facts.label: Players
facts.value: D. C. Cooper (vocals), André Andersen (keyboards and guitars), Steen Mogensen (bass guitar), Jacob Kjaer (guitar), Allan Sørensen (drums), with Maria McTurk, Lise Hansen and Kenny Lubcke on backing vocals

sentences.text: André Andersen wrote the songs, apart from the bonus track 'The Final Lullaby', which Steen Mogensen wrote.
Lars H. Nissen and Royal Hunt handled the mix.

listen_for.text: It is the only instrumental on the album.
